description: Complete PostgreSQL schema for backend/app.py. Source of truth is init_postgres() at backend/app.py:521-643, except sent_reminders_log which is created lazily inside the scheduler job at backend/app.py:2657-2661.

bootstrap.invoked_when: import time, in every gunicorn worker
bootstrap.failure_mode: wrapped in try/except that only prints a warning; app keeps serving with a partial schema
bootstrap.migration_note: No Alembic or equivalent. Idempotency comes from CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS plus ALTER TABLE ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS.

tables.name: users
tables.purpose: Staff and IQAC coordinator identities, roles, forced-password-change flag

columns.name: username
columns.note: Login identifier and join key for every other table

columns.name: password
columns.note: Werkzeug hash only

columns.name: email
columns.note: NOT unique; used as AQAR coordinator discriminator

columns.name: designation
columns.note: Matched with LIKE '%secretary%'

columns.name: role
columns.note: COMMA-SEPARATED LIST, e.g. 'Secretary, Campus IQAC Coordinator'. Indexed. NULL raises AttributeError at login.

columns.name: full_name
columns.note: Added by ALTER at backend/app.py:555 and also present in CREATE

columns.name: must_change_password
columns.note: Added by ALTER at backend/app.py:556; NOT in the CREATE TABLE

tables.seed_data: backend/app.py:629-641 inserts username='admin' password='admin123' must_change_password=TRUE when absent
tables.boot_migration: backend/app.py:624 UPDATE users SET role='School IQAC Coordinator' WHERE role='IQAC Coordinator'
defects: No foreign keys from dependent tables
email not unique though app.py:1741 rejects collisions in application code

tables.name: worklog
tables.purpose: Daily employee activity entries across six categories

columns.name: username
columns.note: No FK to users

columns.name: date
columns.note: TEXT NOT DATE. Holds zero-padded YYYY-MM-DD. All range filters are lexicographic string comparisons.

columns.name: status
columns.note: Holiday / Leave / effectively unused otherwise

columns.name: category
columns.note: Denormalised copy of the primary JSON key

columns.name: task
columns.note: A JSON OBJECT, e.g. {"Documentation and Audits": "..."}. Legacy plaintext tolerated via try/except json.loads.

columns.name: attachment
columns.note: Relative path attachments/<name>; served unauthenticated via /static

defects: No UNIQUE(username, date); dedupe is a racy application check at backend/app.py:981-985
date is TEXT so range filtering depends entirely on ISO formatting
task is JSON in TEXT, so category filtering is a LIKE over serialised JSON

tables.name: signed_reports
tables.purpose: IQAC coordinator monthly submission state machine

columns.name: username
columns.note: No FK

columns.name: reporting_month
columns.note: YYYY-MM; never format-validated at the URL boundary

columns.name: uploaded_file_path
columns.note: Full https:// Cloudinary URL or legacy local path

columns.name: status
columns.note: DDL declares VARCHAR(20); widened by ALTER at backend/app.py:570. In-use values: pending_upload, uploaded, reviewed, corrections_requested

columns.name: remarks
columns.note: Rejection remarks

columns.name: cloudinary_public_id
columns.note: NOT cleared on resubmit (backend/routes/pdf.py:255-262)

defects: CRITICAL: no UNIQUE(username, reporting_month) though the state machine assumes one row per user-month
No index on reporting_month despite being the hottest filter
DELETE-based unlock at backend/app.py:3293-3296 removes all matching duplicates

tables.name: workshop_attachment_files
tables.purpose: Cloudinary references for coordinator workshop uploads

columns.name: workshop_index
columns.note: 1-based in templates (workshop_{i+1}), 0-based in Cloudinary public_id

tables.note: Reconciliation DELETEs then re-INSERTs all rows for the month (backend/app.py:3123-3132, backend/routes/pdf.py:219-231), so id churns on every run.

tables.name: report_drafts
tables.purpose: Autosaved coordinator report form state, serialised as JSON

columns.name: report_type
columns.note: 'standard' or 'aqar_coordinator'

columns.name: form_data
columns.note: Entire report form as JSON. Reads use json.loads with a silent except.

tables.note: The only proper ON CONFLICT upsert in the codebase (backend/app.py:3061-3067). Good model for the new API.

tables.name: app_settings
tables.note: Only these two keys are ever used; read by three divergent implementations.

tables.name: sent_reminders_log
tables.purpose: Reminder idempotency, one row per day
tables.note: DDL executed inside a runtime job. Because APScheduler starts in every gunicorn worker, this table is the only thing preventing N duplicate emails.
